selectionRoots.description: A reachable ordinary Haxe Array length, checked indexing, mutation, copy, arbitrary-range splice, resize, or sort operation.
A reachable ordinary Haxe Array literal for an admitted unboxed element representation.

documentation.runtimeRationale: Ordinary Haxe Array values combine run-time growth with shared mutable identity. A reference-counted container preserves that identity for the admitted acyclic element slice while the compiler keeps fixed arrays and spans direct and runtime-free.
documentation.contract: Implements a move-only resizable unboxed buffer with deterministic checked growth, borrow invalidation, and optional typed element lifecycle callbacks.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: Closed element types and bounded capacities should use a program-local specialized helper when that is smaller and equally correct.

features.summary: Resizable contiguous unboxed storage with checked growth and optional typed element lifecycle callbacks.

documentation.directAlternative: A compiler-known bounded literal Array and separator may fold directly when compile-time work and output size remain reasonable.

selectionRoots.description: A reachable ordinary Haxe Array<String>.join has runtime-dependent elements or separator bytes.

documentation.runtimeRationale: Runtime-sized Array contents need checked growth, ordered separator insertion, one final String owner, and partial-allocation cleanup. A separate composition feature keeps ordinary Array and String programs independent.
documentation.contract: Composes one exact managed Array<String> and immutable separator into a fresh managed String without repeated concatenation.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A closed fixed-capacity program may use a smaller program-local joiner when whole-program bounds prove it sufficient.

features.summary: Linear managed Array<String> joining through one failure-atomic UTF-8 builder.

documentation.directAlternative: Compiler-known immutable byte tables can remain direct const C data when Haxe identity and mutation are unobservable.

selectionRoots.description: A reachable admitted Bytes allocation, range, copy, comparison, or mutation operation.
A reachable haxe.io.Bytes value whose contents or identity live at run time.

documentation.runtimeRationale: General Bytes values have run-time size and shared mutable identity. The selected slice owns that storage without treating arbitrary bytes as text or boxed integers.
documentation.contract: Implements exact-length arbitrary byte buffers, alias-visible mutation, checked copying, explicit UTF-8 String-to-bytes copying, and a validated one-call mutable C-string borrow.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A closed bounded buffer can use a program-local specialization when it preserves the same alias and bounds contract.

features.summary: Fixed-length mutable binary storage with checked ranges and shared Haxe identity.

documentation.contract: Copies one checked Bytes range into a fresh immutable String only after the range is valid UTF-8.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A closed fixed-capacity buffer may use a program-local checked decoder when that preserves bounds, malformed-input failure, and String ownership.

features.summary: Checked UTF-8 decoding from mutable Bytes into an independently owned Haxe String.

selectionRoots.description: A reachable Date constructor needs host timezone and daylight-saving normalization.
A reachable Timer.stamp call needs elapsed time that cannot move backwards with wall-clock adjustments.
A reachable local Date projection needs the host offset at that exact timestamp.
A reachable Date.now call needs the host's adjustable Unix-epoch clock.

documentation.runtimeRationale: Timezone databases, daylight-saving normalization, and clocks are host services. One narrow status/out boundary keeps those effects separate from portable Date arithmetic.
documentation.contract: Reads wall and monotonic clocks separately, converts local civil fields through host timezone rules, and reports Haxe-sign timezone offsets with checked time_t range conversion.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A platform with a closed embedded calendar can replace these calls with a program-local adapter that preserves the same status and clock-kind contracts.

features.summary: Hosted wall-clock, monotonic-clock, local-calendar, and timezone adapters.

documentation.directAlternative: A statically typed value or operation keeps its direct specialized C representation and omits this feature.

selectionRoots.description: A reachable validated HxcIR Dynamic box, cast, field, call, equality, or managed-payload operation.

documentation.runtimeRationale: Observable Dynamic values need one shared tag, type identity, checked scalar access, and managed-root projection across generated C files. The carrier itself remains allocation-free; managed adapters select object and collector support separately.
documentation.contract: Carries one validated Dynamic type identity and active payload without routing ordinary typed values through a universal box.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A closed expression may use direct or program-local specialization only when no Dynamic carrier is observable across that boundary.

features.summary: Private tagged carrier for source-required closed-world Dynamic values.

documentation.directAlternative: A compiler-known immutable enum lookup can remain direct when no shared mutable map value is observable.

selectionRoots.description: A reachable ordinary Haxe EnumValueMap construction, copy, lookup, insertion, removal, clear, or iterator operation.

documentation.programLocalAlternative: A bounded program-local specialization is allowed only when recursive payload equality and class-payload identity remain exact.

features.summary: Recursive enum-value Map keys over the shared exact typed-map runtime.

documentation.contract: Maintains a thread-local stack of active lexical handlers, rooted Dynamic payloads, and exactly-once cleanup callbacks around compiler-owned setjmp sites.
documentation.programLocalAlternative: A complete closed call graph may use generated status propagation when payload matching, cleanup, and observable behavior remain equivalent.

features.summary: Contained same-thread exception frames with rooted payload transport and reverse cleanup.

documentation.programLocalAlternative: A closed program-local region is preferred when the compiler can prove all identities, escapes, and destruction points.

features.summary: Precise non-moving mark-and-sweep collection with explicit exact roots, pins, pressure thresholds, and reports.

A reachable stored Haxe String type whose generated C declaration needs the allocation-free carrier.
